assessment.reason: the probe measured projected source fields; the request path reads stored items

hot_key_pages.note: a Query addresses one partition key, so three packages are three queries that paginate independently

method.note: a single unpaginated Query whose result fills a page reads exactly the 1 MB page limit, so the item count of that page divides into a per-item size without estimating anything
method.why_not_consumed_capacity: the AWS CLI paginates Query and Scan automatically and sums Count and ScannedCount, but reports ConsumedCapacity for one page only; a full-table Scan of 11081 items and a single-partition Query of 1323 items both reported 128.5 capacity units, which cannot be a total for both

observations.interpretation: one full 1 MB page holds 973 GHSA items

observations.interpretation: every projected tensorflow row is readable; the count matches the probe's max_advisories_per_package exactly
observations.label: ghsa_hot_key_complete

observations.interpretation: every admitted row is readable, not merely written; matches the manifest count exactly
observations.label: ghsa_generation_complete

observations.interpretation: the NVD side is one item per partition key by construction, so no NVD query can approach the page limit and its item size is not a request bound
